lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 002: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: US-R1-002 fixed the fail-open blind spot the round-1 reviewer flagged in scripts/check-skip-ratchet.ts:138: `checkSkipRatchet` previously compared only `parseSkipCount(output)` (0 when the ' N skip' line is absent, per Bun's zero-skip convention) against the recorded expectation, with no check that `bun test` actually completed -- a crashed/garbage run ('error: Cannot find module ...\nbun: command crashed\n') has no skip line either and was silently accepted as a clean 0-skip match. Fix (surgical, scoped to scripts/check-skip-ratchet.ts and its unit test only, test/test-in-container.ts left untouched since it doesn't call checkSkipRatchet and wasn't named in the finding): added two new pure exports, `parsePassCount(output): number | null` (parses the ' N pass' line, null when absent) and `suiteRanToCompletion(output): boolean` (true iff Bun's 'Ran N tests across M files.' completion tally line is present), composed into a new `checkSuiteRan(output, passFloor, lane): SkipRatchetResult | null` that `checkSkipRatchet` now runs BEFORE the skip-count comparison: it fails closed (returns a non-null failing result) when either the completion tally line is missing OR the observed pass count is below the lane's recorded `passFloor` in test/helpers/lane-expectations.json (the field the finding noted as recorded-but-unread). This wires the previously-dead `passFloor` field and closes the exact reproduction the reviewer proved empirically (review-artifact.txt SECTION 7). 9 new/updated unit tests added to test/check-skip-ratchet.test.ts (parsePassCount x3, suiteRanToCompletion x3, checkSuiteRan x3) plus 2 new checkSkipRatchet-level cases (crashed-run and under-passFloor), and the 3 pre-existing checkSkipRatchet fixtures were updated to include a 'Ran N tests across M files.' tally line (required now) with passFloor set below the fixture's clean pass count so a single legitimate new skip still clears the floor -- only a crashed/partial run trips it. Real gate re-run clean on this repo: `bun run check:skip-ratchet` -> 'host lane: 0 skip (matches recorded expectation)' (positive-evidence checks pass against the real 5731-pass/0-fail/0-skip host run). Full quality spine green: bun run typecheck 0 errors, bun test 5731 pass / 0 fail / 12933 expect() across 341 files, bun run check:all all 16 gates green (test, embed-vendor, lint, file-size, debt-markers, version-skips, coverage, dead-code, dup, ci-parity, agents-md, test-sleeps, skip-ratchet). No production behavior outside the gate script changed; LaneExpectationsFile/LaneExpectation types and checkSkipCount's signature are unchanged, so test/test-in-container.ts (the only other importer of this module) is unaffected -- verified via its own test file (36 pass / 0 fail). This was the last pending story on this PRD's review-round-1-fix set (US-R1-001 was the prior one); scripts/cam/prd.json's review block should be checked by the supervisor for whether another review round is needed.
